-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.etcd.server.v3.storage.mvcc.BucketRange` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

theorem mvcc.goStringLe_antisymm {a b : GoString} (h1 : go.GoStringLe a b) (h2 : go.GoStringLe b a)
    : a = b

theorem mvcc.goStringLe_trans {a b c : GoString} (h1 : go.GoStringLe a b) (h2 : go.GoStringLe b c) :
    go.GoStringLe a c

def mvcc.bucketRange (m : GMap GoString GoString) (klo khi : GoString) : List (GoString × GoString)
    :=
  (List.filter (fun p => decide (go.GoStringLe klo p.fst) && decide (go.GoStringLt p.fst khi)) m.toList).mergeSort
    fun a b => decide (go.GoStringLe a.fst b.fst)

theorem mvcc.goStringLe_total (a b : GoString) : go.GoStringLe a b ∨ go.GoStringLe b a

theorem mvcc.bucketRange_eq_iff (m : GMap GoString GoString) (klo khi : GoString) (l : List
    (GoString × GoString)) : mvcc.bucketRange m klo khi = l ↔ List.Pairwise go.GoStringLt (List.map
    Prod.fst l) ∧ ∀ (k v : GoString), (k, v) ∈ l ↔ m !! k = some v ∧ go.GoStringLe klo k ∧
    go.GoStringLt k khi
